profile_headline: Business Head at Scanning Pens Ltd l Assistive Technology l EdTech l Dyslexia
post_content: *Home Cooking. Soon it will be a forgotten skill and art !* I am totally frustrated to watch an advertisement by one of these Food Delivery companies where Mother and Son are playing video games. Son stops the game and says he is hungry. The super mom takes her mobile phone, opens the App and orders food on-line and they start playing again. Now this looks very ordinary, but think about it what culture we are getting into. The child's mind is conditioned to the thinking, if you are hungry, order online.. The food delivered to your doorstep is not just food. It is Diabetes, Obesity, High BP. And all other life-threatening companions are made part of your life. Apart from this, the shear joy of cooking for someone and seeing the happiness and satisfaction on the faces of your loved ones is tremendous. You just miss that and thereby missing the family bonding. FOOD is not a Commodity. It is Emotions! So if you are not able to cook even survival food then you are missing something in life. So don't feel proud and say "I can't even make tea." That's pathetic. Future homes will have only the Pantry as there will be no need to cook at home. So start today. Learn and enjoy Cooking. It's good for your health and of your family. And stay away from Zomatoes, Swiggies and Uber Eats.

A politician hires a data scientist for the election campaign. A day before
elections, surveys revealed that he would lose. Pol : Is your sample size
right? DS : Yes sir.! We are doomed this time !! Pol : Is there anything we
can do? DS : Sir, we can try bagging. Pol : I can’t distribute the bags now.
Stickering my name takes time. DS : Sir, it’s not that. Bagging is bootstrap
aggregating where we will create a new population with ‘replacement’. Pol :
Explain in layman terms DS: Sir, just duplicate the samples. Pol : You mean
wipe the ink from some of my voters and make them vote again ?? DS : Exactly
Sir !!. It is a very powerful and efficient technique in ML modeling Pol : Let
the elections complete. I will sue you for copying our age-old techniques and
renaming and selling back to us hashtag#just_for_fun hashtag#voting
